scenarios.label: Baseline
scenarios.description: Tilted forecast. The unconditional forecast reweighted, as little as possible, so that its 2028 medians match the Survey of Professional Forecasters (2026Q3 survey, released 14 August 2026): PCE inflation of 2.12% (fourth quarter over fourth quarter) and real GDP growth of 2.06% (annual average over annual average). Of the inflation measures only PCE is targeted, as in Crump et al. (2021). Nothing is fixed exactly.

scenarios.label: Oil - Pessimistic
scenarios.description: Conditional forecast. Fixes only the WTI oil price: $102.63 a barrel in 2026Q4 and $110 in 2027Q1 and 2027Q2. Everything else, including oil after 2027Q2, is left to the model. The path was written with data to 2026Q2, from oil's 2026Q2 average ($95.75); the 2026Q3 average turned out at $87.22.

scenarios.label: Oil - Optimistic
scenarios.description: Conditional forecast. Fixes only the WTI oil price: $79.17 a barrel in 2026Q4 and $65.46 (its 2025 average) in 2027Q1 and 2027Q2. Everything else, including oil after 2027Q2, is left to the model. The path was written with data to 2026Q2, from oil's 2026Q2 average ($95.75); the 2026Q3 average turned out at $87.22.

scenarios.label: J.P. Morgan midyear
scenarios.description: Conditional forecast. Fixes, roughly as in J.P. Morgan's 2026 midyear outlook (9 July 2026): real GDP growth of 1.75% and core PCE inflation of 3.4% in 2026 (fourth quarter over fourth quarter), and 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields of 4.2% and 4.7% in 2026Q4. Everything else is left to the model. An illustration of scenarios, not the bank's forecast.

scenarios.label: Goldman Sachs oil
scenarios.description: Conditional forecast. Fixes, roughly as in Goldman Sachs research reported on 27 June 2026: core PCE inflation of 3.2% in 2026 and 2.2% in 2027, core CPI inflation of 2.6% and 2.2% (fourth quarter over fourth quarter), and a WTI oil price of $80 a barrel in 2026Q4 and $75 in each quarter of 2027. Everything else is left to the model. An illustration of scenarios, not the bank's forecast.

scenarios.label: PCE anchored at 2%
scenarios.description: Tilted forecast. The unconditional forecast reweighted, as little as possible, so that the median of PCE inflation (four-quarter change) three years ahead, in 2029Q2, is 2%, as in Crump et al. (2021). Nothing is fixed exactly; the model's uncertainty around the anchor is kept.
